_comment: Frozen Maelstrom arena (#102), read by scripts/arena/maelstrom_ground.gd. Game metres, Y up, arena centre at the origin. Gameplay values: changing any of them is a gameplay change (bump WireCodec.BUILD). The playable ice is a ring between the eye and the jagged rim, tilting down toward the bottomless eye (eye_depth) and ending at a rim over a bottomless chasm. A bot whose origin drops below kill_y, or whose centre leaves the ring over the chasm, is eliminated (reason 'maelstrom') instead of being put back on its last floor; its wreck falls until sink_depth below kill_y. Obstacles are authored for one half and mirrored through the centre, with the fleets swapped, so both teams face identical ground. Model hulls come from data/maelstrom_hulls.json (art_source/maelstrom/build_kit.py).
_pad_comment: Start pads lie on the cone (the tracks hold any slope under bot_physics slope_hold_max_degrees). Within pad_radius (easing out over pad_blend metres) the ridges and swells are calmed by pad_calm (share), so no start sits astride a crest.

bowl._comment: The frozen whirlpool's profile is an inverted cone: the ice falls tilt metres in one straight slope from the rim to the eye lip, and a further funnel_depth metres (quadratically, steepest at the lip) over the last stretch inside funnel_outer metres from the centre. A bottomless chasm rings the platform (the frozen sea's ice shelf lies beyond it, sea_below_rim metres under the rim): a bot whose centre leaves the ring by more than exit_margin metres is eliminated too.

swell._comment: Broad frozen swells following the spin: sin(2 * spiral phase) times height metres, fading near the eye and the rim.

ridge._comment: Frozen spiral pressure ridges, arms of them (even, for point symmetry; log spirals r = eye_radius * exp(twist * angle), evenly spaced): a sharp tent profile height metres tall and half_width metres to each side of the crest, fading out near the eye and the rim.

slabs._comment: Frozen waves (one-way ramps): each rises along yaw over length to height with a curling crest and a sheer drop beyond it; its sides taper into the ice across width. Authored for one half and mirrored.

art._fog_comment: Blizzard: depth fog clear to fog_begin metres from the camera, thickening to fog_density (0..1 opacity) by fog_end.
